title: ValidateRequest
description:
EdgeProof backtest reality-check. Submit realized P&L (never your strategy);
get a verdict on whether the edge is real or curve-fit noise.

trades.title: Trades
trades.description: Alternative to 'returns': rows with a return field (ret/pnl/net_bps) and optional 'entry'/'exit' bar indices for honest purged k-fold timing. Include 'coin' and 'ts'/'timestamp' on each row to also unlock a 4th check (S226): a concentration jackknife (does the total sign flip once you exclude the single best trade or the single dominant coin) and a BTC-regime overlay (does the sign differ inside vs outside a BTC melt-up window). Both are additive — never change verdict/DSR/permutation_p_value/kfold_decay_rho, they surface under a separate 'concentration_and_regime' key only when coin/ts context is present.

n_trials.title: N Trials
n_trials.description: How many strategy variants/params you tried before selecting this one. Be honest — more trials = bigger Deflated-Sharpe haircut.

trial_sharpes.title: Trial Sharpes
trial_sharpes.description: Optional: Sharpes of all variants tried → exact DSR variance.
